title: Flood Watch before a big rain
summary: A slow-moving storm is forecast to drop over 2 inches of rain. NWS issues a Flood Watch. Rivers are still normal. Shows the Watch level.

alerts.headline: FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING THROUGH SUNDAY MORNING
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. * WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.
* WHERE...York, Chester, and Lancaster counties.
* WHEN...From this evening through Sunday morning.
* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood Warnings.
